mapper.insert: INSERT INTO content_moderations (target_type, target_id, target_user_id, status, reason, admin_note, created_by) VALUES (#{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{targetUserId}, #{status}, #{reason}, #{adminNote}, #{createdBy})
mapper.sql: id, target_type, target_id, target_user_id, status, reason, admin_note, created_by, created_at, restored_at, restored_by, restore_reason

SELECT 'POST' AS target_type, p.id AS target_id, NULL AS parent_id, p.title AS title, p.content AS content_snippet, p.user_id AS author_user_id FROM user_posts p UNION ALL SELECT 'COURSE', c.id, NULL, c.title, c.content, c.user_id FROM courses c UNION ALL SELECT 'POST_COMMENT', pc.id, pc.post_id, NULL, pc.content, pc.user_id FROM post_comments pc UNION ALL SELECT 'COURSE_COMMENT', cc.id, cc.course_id, NULL, cc.content, cc.user_id FROM course_comments cc UNION ALL SELECT 'DESTINATION_COMMENT', dc.id, dc.destination_id, NULL, dc.content, dc.user_id FROM destination_comments dc
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM content_moderations cm JOIN () t ON t.target_type = cm.target_type AND t.target_id = cm.target_id JOIN users author ON author.id = t.author_user_id

SELECT cm.id AS moderation_id, cm.target_type, cm.target_id, cm.reason, cm.created_at, t.parent_id, t.title, LEFT(t.content_snippet, 200) AS content_snippet, t.author_user_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(author.nickname, ''), author.username) AS author_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(admin_user.nickname, ''), admin_user.username) AS admin_name FROM content_moderations cm JOIN () t ON t.target_type = cm.target_type AND t.target_id = cm.target_id JOIN users author ON author.id = t.author_user_id JOIN users admin_user ON admin_user.id = cm.created_by
ORDER BY cm.created_at DESC, cm.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE content_moderations SET status = 'RESTORED', restored_at = #{restoredAt}, restored_by = #{restoredBy}, restore_reason = #{restoreReason} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
